entry.author: Eastern Institute Of Technology
entry.summary:
From hesitation at the door to life changing learning, Antony Ruru’s (Te Aitanga-a-Mahaki, Ngāti Porou) journey into Te Reo Māori at EIT. 

We’re excited to share this heartfelt kōrero from Bachelor of Arts (Māori) graduate, Antony Ruru.

In this video, Anthony reflects on the moment that changed everything, sitting in his car outside EIT, unsure if he was ready to take that next step. After three attempts at reaching for the door, it was a warm “Kia ora, do you want to come in?” from staff member Ange that finally welcomed him inside and set him on a new path.

Growing up in Tairāwhiti with his mum and grandmother speaking Te Reo at home, to enrolling in Te Whakangungutanga ki Ngā Tāiro a Kupe | Bachelor of Arts (Māori), Anthony describes his study journey as one of the best experiences of his life. A journey that helped him reconnect with te ao Māori, strengthen his identity, and grow in ways he never expected.

If you’re thinking about studying Te Reo, reconnecting with your culture, or taking a step you’re not quite sure you’re ready for, Antony’s story shows just how transformative that first “yes” can be.
